snippet.title: Angry Birds 2: Offline Mode Returns!
snippet.description:
Out hiking? Going on vacation? Commuting to work? It doesn’t matter; you can now enjoy Angry Birds 2 both online and offline! Take on the Daily Challenge and King Pig Panic, play through the Saga levels like normal, and watch your Treasure Pass quest progress sync up when back online. Spend Gems and Black Pearls even when offline.
